name: feature.tool-output-compaction.nodes
description: Tool-output compaction node — compacts a verbose JSON payload mid-workflow, using the same kernel as the automatic tool-result boundary. The default lossless mode DELETES INSIGNIFICANT WHITESPACE ONLY and changes no other byte; the optional lossy mode drops empty fields and shortens long lists of objects, each disclosed in the payload (ADR 0604, ADR 0999). Pure and deterministic, so recorded output is replay-safe.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Compact Tool Output
nodes.description: Compacts a JSON string to cut token spend before it reaches a model. The default lossless mode deletes insignificant whitespace ONLY — no field is added or removed and no other byte changes. The optional lossy mode additionally drops structurally-empty fields (disclosed as _emptied) and shortens long lists of objects (disclosed as _elided); lists of plain values such as ids are never shortened. Non-JSON passes through untouched.
